mapper.select: SELECT latest.peer_id AS peerUserId, u.username AS peerUsername, u.alias AS peerAlias, u.avatar AS peerAvatar, pm.content AS lastMessage, pm.created_at AS lastMessageTime, IFNULL(unread.unread_count, 0) AS unreadCount FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN from_user_id = #{userId} THEN to_user_id ELSE from_user_id END AS peer_id, MAX(created_at) AS max_created_at FROM private_message WHERE from_user_id = #{userId} OR to_user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY CASE WHEN from_user_id = #{userId} THEN to_user_id ELSE from_user_id END ) latest JOIN private_message pm ON ( CASE WHEN pm.from_user_id = #{userId} THEN pm.to_user_id ELSE pm.from_user_id END ) = latest.peer_id AND pm.created_at = latest.max_created_at LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = latest.peer_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT from_user_id AS peer_id, COUNT(*) AS unread_count FROM private_message WHERE to_user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 GROUP BY from_user_id ) unread ON unread.peer_id = latest.peer_id ORDER BY pm.created_at DESC
